title: Normalization and Barcode Addition
author: Opentrons
materials: Buffer A added to barcode plate
Buffer B added to barcode plate

steps.title: Load CSV and configure transfers
steps.instruction: Upload the CSV file that defines the transfers. Column 1 contains the destination well (identical to the source well, 1:1 mapping). Column 4 contains the DNA transfer volume and column 5 contains the water transfer volume. The file must have a single header row. If "top half of plate" or "bottom half of plate" is selected, the multi‑channel pipette will pick up four tips, always aspirate from the top four rows of the 96‑well final plate located in slot 3, and dispense into the corresponding wells of the barcode plate (top or bottom half as selected). This sets up all subsequent water, DNA, sample, and buffer transfers.

steps.title: Add water to final plate
steps.instruction: For each well, read the water volume from CSV column 5. If the volume is ≥ 5 µL, aspirate and dispense exactly 5 µL of water into the well on the final plate (slot 3) using the multi‑channel pipette configured in step 1.

steps.title: Add DNA to final plate
steps.instruction: For each well, read the DNA volume from CSV column 4. If the volume is > 6 µL, dispense 6 µL of DNA; if the volume is < 1 µL, dispense 1 µL; otherwise dispense the exact volume indicated. Use the same pipette settings as in step 1.

steps.title: Add samples to barcode plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the normalized sample from each source well (same well as the destination) to the corresponding well on the barcode plate. Dispense into the top half, bottom half, or the full plate according to the user selection, while still aspirating from the top four rows of the final plate on slot 3.

steps.title: Add Buffer A to barcode plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the required volume of Buffer A into each well of the barcode plate using the standard aspiration rate.

steps.title: Add Buffer B to barcode plate
steps.instruction: Dispense Buffer B into each well of the barcode plate using a slow aspiration rate and a pause after aspiration to accommodate its high viscosity.

steps.title: Pool column samples
steps.instruction: Combine (pool) samples from columns 2‑6 into column 1, and combine samples from columns 7‑11 into column 12 of the barcode plate.
